faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bengal Chemicals Legal Retainer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Legal Retainer post at Bengal Chemicals is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal Retainer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) from a recognized University/Institute approved by the Bar Council of India. Additionally, they need to have a minimum of ten years of continuous membership with a State Bar Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Legal Retainer recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Legal Retainer post is not exceeding 40 years as on the date of the advertisement. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/PWD candidates and as per government directives.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Legal Retainer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly professional fee of Rs. 35,000/-. Statutory deductions like TDS and Income Tax will be made at source from this amount.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Bengal Chemicals Legal Retainer vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the prescribed application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with self-attested copies of testimonials to the Sr. Manager (HR & Admin.) at the given address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals for the Legal Retainer position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Legal Retainer position?
faq.answer: The Legal Retainer position at Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is PER/0106/2026-2027/2. This number should be mentioned on the application envelope.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job location for the Legal Retainer post is Kolkata, West Bengal, at the premises of Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Kolkata, West Bengal. While not explicitly stated that only West Bengal residents can apply, candidates from other states should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and are willing to relocate if selected.
